text:
Ellie R: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem — want to lock owners and timelines for the token-ingest gap + invoice correction path. I pasted the action list from the doc below. Please reply with ✅ when you own something or with an ETA.

Ellie R: ACTIONS: 
• Root cause validation (eng) — confirm whether late telemetry or dedupe bug. owner: Tom H, ETA: Fri EOD
• Backfill plan + cost estimate (infra) — SQL + backfill script, staged run, safety limits. owner: Kai L, ETA: Mon
• Invoice adjustment plan (finance) — PR + customer comms template. owner: Maria P, ETA: Tue
• Daily regression monitor (ops) — alerting rule for delayed ingestion spikes. owner: Zainab S, ETA: Wed
• Postmortem writeup final + followups (prod) — link to runbook and retention. owner: Ellie R, ETA: Thu

Tom H: Re root cause — initial look suggests a race during async token ingestion where the webhook ack was retried and dedupe failed. I can confirm with logs by EOD.

Kai L: For the backfill, I sketched a safe query. We need approval on a max_token_budget before we run. SQL:
```sql
-- sample to re-ingest missing deltas
INSERT INTO usage_ingest (user_id, ts, tokens)
SELECT user_id, ts, tokens FROM staging_missing_tokens WHERE processed = false LIMIT 100000;
```
I'll add batching and a throttler. Estimate cost ~ $600 for the first pass (GPU/IO).

Maria P: I'll draft the invoice correction PR and a one-paragraph customer note. Quick question: do we want to auto-credit affected customers or handle case-by-case? leaning auto-credit for < $50 incidents.

Zainab S: I'll add the monitor rule and a daily digest to #finance-incidents. Suggest alert: ingestion_delay > 30m & token_delta > 5%. Who should get paging on weekends?

Ellie R: Good Q on paging. Let's route paging to oncall-eng + finance-oncall for weekends for 24h after a new incident. Add that to the runbook.

Tom H: Confirmed — logs show ~2.1M events retried and ~0.8% dedupe miss window. Pinpointing the retry handling right now. ETA EOD still.

Kai L: Added a draft backfill playbook in the docs and a dry-run flag. Running dry-run tomorrow 09:00 PT — tagging everyone. Will output a token_cost.csv and a safety_kpi report.

Maria P: Auto-credit policy agreed for < $50. For > $50 escalate to finance lead. I'll prepare the PR and sample comms.

Zainab S: Paging set to oncall-eng + finance-oncall for weekends in the draft alert. Also added a rate-limit check to avoid backfill storms.

Ellie R: Thanks. One more — recurring pattern check: Tom, can you run a 90-day histogram of ingestion delay and drop into the postmortem doc? I think we should mark recurring if >3 occurrences in 90d.

Tom H: Will do. Dropping the histogram link when ready.

BillingBot: [Automated] Created task: FIN-BILL-3123 (backfill dry-run) assigned to Kai L, due 1904587634.

Ellie R: Great. Summary of owners/ETAs: Tom H (root cause) — Fri EOD; Kai L (backfill + dry-run) — Mon/dry-run tomorrow; Maria P (invoice PR + comms) — Tue; Zainab S (monitor + paging) — Wed; Ellie R (final writeup) — Thu.

Ellie R: Please react with ✅ when you confirm. I'll update the incident tracker and ping again tomorrow AM in #finance-ops.

Tom H: ✅

Kai L: ✅ (dry-run scheduled)

Maria P: ✅ (PR draft in progress)

Zainab S: ✅

Ellie R: Thanks all — will follow up with the updated tracker link and the final postmortem writeup.
